title: DataContract
description: The declarative contract a table of rows must satisfy: per-field types and constraints, and table-level keys, referential integrity, and shape. This is the open standard for verifiable data cleaning; SDK implementations load this schema as data and validate against it rather than mirroring it in code. A contract's verdict is data validity (does the table meet its declared quality bar), distinct from a derivation claim's verdict of inferential soundness.

specVersion.description: The version of the Data Contract Spec this manifest conforms to.

kind.description: The manifest kind. Always 'DataContract' for this schema.

description.description: Human- and agent-readable summary of what the contract guards.

fields.description: Per-column type and constraint declarations, in column order.

name.description: The column name this field describes.

type.description: The column's declared value type. Validation checks that each present value parses as this type without mutating it (coercion is a separate, explicit stage).

mostly.description: The fraction of present values that must satisfy this field's constraints for the field to pass (a tolerance for a small share of violations). Missing values are judged only by 'required', never by the value constraints. Default 1 (strict).

allOf.description: A numeric range applies only to numeric types.
Length and pattern apply only to strings.

constraints.description: Value-level constraints. Which apply is gated by the field's type (see the field's conditional rules); an unsupported constraint for a type is a spec violation.

required.description: Every value must be present (not missing).

minimum.description: The smallest allowed value (inclusive) for a numeric field.

maximum.description: The largest allowed value (inclusive) for a numeric field.

minLength.description: The shortest allowed length for a string field.

maxLength.description: The longest allowed length for a string field.

pattern.description: A regular expression each string value must match (unanchored; anchor with ^ and $ to require a full match).

enum.description: The closed set of allowed values.

fields.description: The local columns whose values must exist in the referenced resource.

resource.description: The name of the referenced resource (a dataset or an upstream derivation). Referential integrity edges are edges in the derivation DAG.

fields.description: The referenced columns, positionally matched to 'fields'.

table.description: Table-level constraints over the whole set of rows.

primaryKey.description: Columns whose combined value is present and unique across all rows.

uniqueKeys.description: Additional column sets whose combined value must be unique.

rowCount.description: Bounds on the number of rows.

columnsMatch.description: Require the table's columns to be exactly the declared fields, in order, with no extras or omissions (a schema-drift guard).
